method: Native helper comparisons use identical captured or synthetic inputs and compare complete output maps. Observer diagnostics sample unchanged 8192-step boundaries; inclusive timings overlap and total intervals include signal and idle-boundary variation. Unprofiled physical latency starts at actual dispatch and ends at the first complete-frame physical ACK containing the character. Scheduling delay is additional.

diagnostic_before.method: Signals bracket actual first send_text through observation of its complete offer. Sampling occurs at unchanged 8192-step owner boundaries; start/stop resolution is one boundary plus signal delivery. Packed phase transitions are separate; guest stacks use existing suspension snapshots. Method timers are inclusive and must not be added together. Wall times include observer cost and are not latency benchmarks.

supervisor.note: Outer watchdog includes image packaging and is no larger than the canonical budget.

diagnostic_before.word_table_selection: Top 80 inclusive and leaf words by sampled steps, plus named service/ownership checks; full groups remain in the hashed raw artifact.
diagnostic_before.native_exits_selection: Top 40 by count; complete counters remain in the hashed raw artifact.
diagnostic_before.control_capture_limitation: The initial new bank observer read graph owner cells instead of ID cells. Discard those ID samples; they were rejected by the helper replay. Correctly captured correlation records, phase/stack samples and frozen native counters remain usable. The corrected observer reads the production ID offset and is bound by an additional observer hash. Captured-bank replay uses fixed-y5cb8bba.
